name: First days in space
laika: Welcome to microgravity! Fluids shift toward your head and you may feel dizzy while your body adapts.

name: Journey to Mars
laika: Mars is about 140 million miles from Earth on average. Help from home gets slower, so we check ourselves.

name: On Mars
laika: We landed! Mars has about three-eighths of Earth's gravity, so muscles, bones and balance adjust again.

name: Return journey
laika: Back in microgravity on the way home. Keep exercising to protect bone and muscle.

name: Back on Earth
laika: Home! Balance, blood pressure and strength need checks while you readapt to Earth's gravity.
